definitions.explanation: A large formal meeting of a political party's members, held to decide policy, elect leaders, or set direction. A common term in political news.

examples.japanese: {党大会|とうたいかい}が{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: A party convention is being held.

examples.japanese: {党大会|とうたいかい}で{新|あたら}しい{代表|だいひょう}が{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: A new leader was chosen at the party convention.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{党大会|とうたいかい}では、{来年|らいねん}の{選挙|せんきょ}に{向|む}けた{方針|ほうしん}が{示|しめ}された。
examples.english: At this year's party convention, the policy direction for next year's election was laid out.

notes:
Formed from {党|とう} (party) + {大会|たいかい} (convention, large meeting). Refers to a political party's top decision-making assembly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {党大会|とうたいかい}を{開|ひら}く: to hold a party convention
- {党大会|とうたいかい}で{決|き}める: to decide at a party convention
- {臨時|りんじ}{党大会|とうたいかい}: an extraordinary (special) party convention

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大会|たいかい}: convention; large gathering; tournament — the general word, not limited to politics.
- {総会|そうかい}: general meeting — a general assembly of members of any organization.
